data.gender_notes: Malvin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'MALUS', meaning 'bad' or 'evil'. Malvin is a diminutive form of Malachias, which translates to 'my angel'. In Christianity, Malachias is considered an angelic name, a servant of God. The name Malvin carries the meaning “Little servant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Malvin usually hope their child will grow to embody little servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and servitude to God.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malvin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This name is a source of comfort and hope for those who bear it, reminding them of God's unending love and care.
